fields.label: Tax Identification Number
fields.description: Mã số thuế (Tax Identification Number) issued to enterprises, cooperatives, organizations and other taxpayers for tax administration.

fields.label: Dependent Unit Tax Identification Number
fields.description: 13-digit tax identification number with a hyphen separating the first 10 digits from the final 3 digits, used for dependent units and other qualifying taxpayers.

fields.label: Personal Identification Number as Tax Identification Number
fields.description: 12-digit personal identification number issued under Vietnam's identification law and used as the tax identification number for eligible Vietnamese individuals, households and household businesses from 1 July 2025.
